nodes.label: Drawdown Math Bar Chart (docs)
nodes.description: Bar chart titled 'Математика разорения: почему просадку легче не получить, чем потом отыграть'. X-axis: deposit drawdown percentage (0–100%). Y-axis: required recovery percentage to break even (0–2000%). Shows exponential relationship: 5% drawdown requires 5% recovery, 50% drawdown requires 100%, 80% drawdown requires 400%, 90% drawdown requires 900%, 95% drawdown requires 1900%.

nodes.label: Drawdown (concept)
nodes.description: Forex/trading concept: просадка депозита (deposit drawdown) — percentage loss from peak equity.

nodes.label: Recovery Factor Math (concept)
nodes.description: Mathematical concept: to recover from a drawdown of D%, you need 1/(1-D/100)-1 * 100% gain. E.g. 50% loss requires 100% gain, 90% loss requires 900% gain.
